mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM ops_permission p WHERE p.permission_id = #{permissionId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT DISTINCT p.perm_code FROM ops_permission p JOIN ops_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.permission_id JOIN ops_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT DISTINCT ur.user_id FROM ops_user_role ur JOIN ops_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id JOIN ops_permission p ON p.permission_id = rp.permission_id JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id = ur.user_id WHERE p.perm_code = #{permCode} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ur.user_id >= 100000001 ORDER BY ur.user_id

SELECT DISTINCT ur.user_id FROM ops_user_role ur JOIN ops_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id = ur.user_id WHERE r.role_key = #{roleKey} AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ur.user_id >= 100000001 ORDER BY ur.user_id
